stimuli.readingPassage: Hi! My name is John. I'm an 11th grade student. In the future, I am going to choose a job I love. I enjoy learning new things, so I'm trying to improve my skills. I am good at drawing, and I want to take up graphic design as a hobby. My grandfather tells me that life used to be harder. People used to use oil lamps because there was no electricity. Last night, while I was studying, the lights went out. I found a candle and continued reading. I also read about successful people. Some scientists made great discoveries and won important awards. Their stories inspire me.
stimuli.audioTranscript: Interviewer: Today, we are with Dr. Selim. Dr. Selim, did you always want to be a doctor? Dr. Selim: No. When I was a child, I used to dream of being a pilot. I loved planes. But in high school, I became interested in biology and helping people. So, I decided to study medicine. It was a difficult journey, but I graduated in 2010. Now, I love my job. In the future, I am going to open a small clinic in my village to help the elderly.
